verdict.rationale: Poke documents natural-language reminders, Recipes for setting up automations, and an API that external tools such as CI/CD pipelines or monitoring can use to trigger it. It is also described as a proactive assistant. Together these suggest time- and event-driven behavior, but none of the evidence explicitly describes scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: explicit recurring or cron-style scheduling of tasks or workflows, documentation of managing schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
